## MARK RENDÓN
### Green Party Candidate for CA AD14
I am an educator, musician, and community organizer. For 29 years, I was a Music Teacher in the Oakland Unified School District and an elected member of the Oakland Education Association.
I am running to address housing, healthcare, education, and other challenges in our district. I refuse corporate and superPAC donations so I am accountable to YOU.
As a longtime registered Green, I champion our core values for People. Planet. Peace.
AD14 DISTRICT MAP, encompassing: Berkeley, Albany, Piedmont, a portion of North Oakland, Bayview, East Richmond Heights, El Cerrito, El Sobrante, Hercules, Kensington, Montalvin Manor, North Richmond, Pinole, Richmond, Rodeo, Rollingwood, San Pablo, and Tara Hills
### PRIORITIES
HOUSING & AFFORDABILITY: Homes not handcuffs
UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE & CALCARE: Healthcare is a human right
PUBLIC EDUCATION: Education is an investment, not a debt sentence
CLIMATE & PUBLIC POWER: Climate policies for today and our future
JUSTICE & DEMOCRACY: Representatives who answer to you, not the biggest check
Learn more
### Follow my campaign on social media!

## ENDORSEMENTS
Mark Rendón is proud to be supported by community leaders, public servants, progressive organizers, candidates, and organizations working across the East Bay and California.
We are grateful for YOUR support and endorsement.
Endorse Mark
### ORGANIZATIONS
The California DSA recommended Mark Rendón for State Assembly in AD-14.
### INDIVIDUALS
Soli Alpert — Chair, Berkeley Rent Board
Ida Martinac — Berkeley Rent Board Commissioner
Boona Cheema — Former Executive Director, BOSS
Margot Smith — 2024 candidate for State Assembly, District 14
Robert Lieber — Former Mayor of Albany
Dr. Butch Ware — 2026 Primary Candidate for California Governor
Moni Gangopadhyay — Candidate for Berkeley City Council, District 1
Syrak Micael — Candidate for Berkeley City Council, District 7
Vylma Ortiz — Candidate for Berkeley Rent Board
John Selawsky — Former President, BUSD Board of Education; former Chair, Berkeley Rent Board
Marjorie Mikels — 2026 Primary Candidate for State Attorney General
Glenn Turner — 2026 Primary Candidate for State Treasurer
Don Macleay — Former candidate for Oakland Mayor
Laura Wells — Former candidate for California Governor
“Mark Rendón would push for a Medicare-for-All style healthcare, unlike his opponent, the incumbent, who blocked healthcare and did not even allow the legislature to vote on it.”
Orlando Johnson — Former candidate for Oakland Mayor
Phoebe Thomas Sorgen — Former Berkeley City Council candidate
Greg Jan — Council Member, Green Party of Alameda County
Nassim Nouri — Green Party of Santa Clara County Council
Jon Sternberg — Retired Nurse, CA Nurses Association
Stan Woods — Member, KPFA, Local Station Board
Dr. Shaina Maxey Pomerantz — 2024 Candidate for Oregon Attorney General; Lawyer, educator, advocate
“I’ve known Mark for over 20 years through our capoeira community. In that time we have forged the bond of family through our shared values, protesting war, championing education, and our love of music and capoeira.”
John Callaway — Retired Professor
“Mark Rendón is a true leader on environmental issues. We need to move beyond our current assemblymember and embrace a leader for the challenges of the 21st century.”
Stephen Josephson — Retire resident
“…more Green Party members are needed in the political arena to truly represent the viewpoints and beliefs of all citizens of California who think independently away from traditional 2 party belief points of view.”
Mari Mendonca — Organizer/Advocate
“Mark is a dedicated community educator, leader and organizer. He will bring his integrity, hard work ethic and a deep commitment to the equitable vitality of our region for all constituents.”
Suzanne Baker — Archaeologist
Steve Wedgwood
Craig Gordon — Retired Oakland teacher/current substitute, Oakland Education Association representative
“I've known Mark for many years as a fellow public schools teacher and union representative. He has been fighter for quality public education and workers' rights for decades.”
David Gassman — 35 year long resident of Oakland
* Individual endorsers’ affiliations are included for identification purposes only
### Endorse Mark
By completing this form to endorse Mark Rendón on behalf of your organization or as an individual, you are joining us to bring true representation to Assembly District 14.
